title: Accidental Double Hit During Stroke
question: You are playing a chip shot from just off the green. As you swing, your club accidentally strikes the ball twice in the same stroke. The ball finishes just a few feet from the hole. What is the correct ruling?

choices.text: Count the stroke and add a one-stroke penalty.
Count the stroke and add a two-stroke penalty.
Count it as one stroke with no penalty.
Cancel the stroke and play the shot again.

explanation: If a player accidentally hits the ball more than once during a single stroke, there is no penalty. The stroke counts as one stroke only, regardless of how many times the club contacts the ball during that swing. This changed in 2019; previously there was a penalty.
